column1: # Measured wall seconds of one package under `go test` in the go-quality test leg (CHAOS-10355), the weight ci/go_race_shard.awk balances the test shards by
# (`check_go.sh ci-leg test K N`). Re-measured at 10 test legs (CHAOS-13622): MEDIAN (rounded to whole seconds) of the uncached `ok <pkg> <n>s` lines of the test legs of the 5 successful
# full-plan go-quality push runs on main since the 10-leg plan (43366218676, 43369751192, 43376042584, 43377857475, 43379257796; up to 5 values per package). A split package's
# (ci/go_test_splits.tsv) value of one run is the sum of its parts' lines: the weight of the whole package.
# Rows: every package of median >= 20 s, and every package that already had a row (a row of a package with no uncached line in those runs keeps its earlier value), among them the
# packages the unweighted-slow guard flagged on a starved shard (internal/auth/identity/saml, internal/cigates/bigboyrender, internal/auth/identity; CHAOS-13422). A package with no row weighs 1.
# No part rows (CHAOS-13668): the test-leg plan derives a split package's part weights from its test rows in ci/go_test_split_weights.tsv; a <key>#<part> row is refused.
# The weights only need to be roughly right: a wrong one costs balance, never coverage (the shards always partition `go list ./...`). Key = import path relative to the module root.
# Sorted (LC_ALL=C), no duplicates; internal/cigates/testshard checks each row names a real package.
